newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets quiet, eye US futures.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets quiet, eye US futures.

text.p: Several traders saw evidence of underlying demand for cotton for shipment in the next few months, but most European raw cotton markets were quiet as they awaited latest U.S. statistics.
In the event, the Department of Agriculture's revised forecast of U.S. 1997/98 production, at 18.5 million bales, was toward the upper end of private expectations.
Both buyers and sellers are now watching the reaction of New York futures.
